stories.title: Police dog tracks robbery suspect through graveyard and fields in Flintshire
stories.summary: A police dog followed a scent through a graveyard and into open fields to find a suspect in north Flintshire after a robbery last night. stories.title: Power cut hits part of Flint with supply due back by 3pm
stories.summary: Part of Flint is without power this morning after an unplanned power cut, with SP Energy Networks aiming to restore supplies by 3.03pm.

stories.title: Number in temporary housing in Flintshire up 88% in under three years as Wales total falls
stories.summary: The number of people living in temporary accommodation in Flintshire has risen by 88% in less than three years, while the total across Wales has fallen. Welsh Government figures show 563 homeless people were in temporary housing in Flintshire at the end of August 2026. At the end of October 2023 the figure was 300.

stories.title: School leaders across Wales vote for strike action in pay and funding dispute
stories.summary: School leaders across Wales have voted for industrial action, including strike action, in a dispute over pay, funding and workload.
